notes.manas-2010:p0036:b002:l009: Туубай туна чөгөлү is a difficult formula; draft interprets the literal born/not-born and sinking imagery as wishing to vanish as if never born. Exact туна force unresolved; no source emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0036:b002:l032: Кызыталак is a harsh sexual insult. Draft uses fucking to retain its abusive register, without claiming a word-for-word etymological equivalent. Repeated occurrences in this batch use the same rendering.
notes.manas-2010:p0036:b002:l037: Колдогусун is visibly printed thus and remains lexically uncertain. Helpless is a contextual reading with биз жетим (we orphans), not a verified correction to колдоосуз.
notes.manas-2010:p0036:b002:l040: Азирет retained in meaning as holy lord; the invokee is not securely identified in this line and is not supplied as Ali or Muhammad.
notes.manas-2010:p0036:b002:l046: Visible амаз is interpreted as defective намаз (ritual prayer) in the draft; raw source unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0037:b002:l005: Кара байыр retained as the horse term karabayyr; казанат rendered noble warhorse. This is epic horse terminology, not a certified modern breed identification.
notes.manas-2010:p0037:b002:l006: Literal sieve-like lungs and copper limbs retained as conventional images of equine endurance.
notes.manas-2010:p0037:b002:l008: Lines 8–11 form an awkward topographic sequence in the PDF; the draft follows the visible mountain/river/spur images without repairing its syntax.
notes.manas-2010:p0037:b002:l012: Супа садык is the traditional true-dawn formula (Arabic subh sadiq), rendered true dawn; repeated at 53:39.
notes.manas-2010:p0037:b002:l020: Eighty is explicitly printed here; ninety at 37:23 is also retained. No attempt to harmonize the epic numeral inconsistency. Kalday retained as source term rather than assigning a specific Chinese administrative grade.
notes.manas-2010:p0038:b002:l001: Жөө желдет treated as the messenger’s epithet/name Jöö Jeldet, literally foot executioner/henchman; proper-name status is provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0038:b002:l021: Кайыпка катар is interpreted as supernatural swiftness, rendered swift as vanished spirits; the precise image remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0038:b002:l022: Илек-илек retained as ilek upon ilek, the epic multitude expression; no exact arithmetic headcount supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0039:b002:l002: Кыйылып is visibly printed. Lowered is a contextual spear-position reading; a defective word or variant cannot be ruled out.
notes.manas-2010:p0039:b002:l011: Карапчы glossed as ancient defensive armor in the 2015 Kyrgyz explanatory dictionary, https://el-sozduk.kg/карап/ ; armored coat follows its combination with тон.
notes.manas-2010:p0039:b002:l024: Карыпчысын appears to be a variant/defect of карапчы in the nearby clothing description; draft uses armored coats, provisionally.
notes.manas-2010:p0039:b002:l031: Каркыбар is an epic praise/intensifying term for prowess, not treated as a new character. Kyrgyz explanatory dictionary at https://mamtil.gov.kg/storage/post/file/93f73d2b0d1e97340369eee4d6fa6cdca210e229.pdf ; similarly mighty in 45:2 and 55:14.
notes.manas-2010:p0039:b002:l035: Он беш төлдөптүр permits ambiguity between fifteen offspring and fifteen instances of bearing. Draft chooses fifteen cubs in the guardian-tiger description; repeated at 49:41.
notes.manas-2010:p0039:b002:l038: Алтайчылык is visibly printed; draft contextually reads алты айчылык, six months ahead. This is an interpretation, not corrected Kyrgyz transcription.
notes.manas-2010:p0039:b002:l042: Visible бурку илийди is defective. Draft interprets it with Yudakhin бурку илим, branches of learning, exemplified by sixty Manchu sciences at https://el-sozduk.kg/бурк/ ; exact lost morphology remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0040:b002:l018: Lines 18–19 are grammatically awkward. Draft understands the general populace as uninvolved in attacking the champions, contrasted with Karakan’s sons at 20–22; referents are provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0041:b002:l009: Бор in the firing context rendered cannon provisionally; exact weapon subtype not established.
notes.manas-2010:p0041:b002:l017: Кынжылалуу understood through Yudakhin кынжыла- (collar/muzzle; epic champions brought on a leash), https://el-sozduk.kg/кын/ . Corrected the initial dagger reading during same-agent lexical review.
notes.manas-2010:p0041:b002:l023: Subject transition in 23–26 is implicit. Draft attaches the destructive might to the attacking infidels, following 26, not to the orphaned sons.
notes.manas-2010:p0042:b002:l034: Күрө rendered bandits in parallel with каракчы; exact historical sense remains a lexical blocker.
notes.manas-2010:p0043:b002:l020: Бирөөнү and parallel occurrences retain one, referring distributively to a son/group in the forced division. Singular referent versus accompanying households remains implicit in the source.
notes.manas-2010:p0043:b002:l021: Ийрен retained as Iyren rather than silently modernized to Iran; precise geography unresolved. Same treatment in 43:39, 51:15 and 52:2.
notes.manas-2010:p0044:b002:l005: Менде interpreted as пенде, mortal/servant. Capitalized Your makes the plea a prayer; the addressee shifts from Karakan in 44:2 and remains implicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0044:b002:l018: Кээсин is visible but uncertain. Every last hidden cry of anguish is a contextual interpretation, not a secure dictionary meaning; requires specialist collation.
notes.manas-2010:p0044:b002:l023: Денекул uses the established preceding-batch rendering slaves for life; not replaced by a milder servant term.
notes.manas-2010:p0044:b002:l031: Camels and heroic giants appear around the same slaughter verb in 31–33. Draft preserves both objects without inventing a missing verb or line.
notes.manas-2010:p0044:b002:l034: Уз understood as a skilled craftswoman; the source does not specify her craft.
notes.manas-2010:p0044:b002:l044: Эңкейиштеп бас is visibly awkward. Low downward slope is a provisional literal image paired with the small Kyrgyz force; no emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0045:b002:l024: Көк жал is the gray-maned wolf-derived heroic epithet; gray-maned retained. Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/kok-18/ gives the wolf and fearless-hero senses.
notes.manas-2010:p0045:b002:l028: Бил interpreted as variant пил, elephant, supported contextually by 49:31 and explicit пилим at 49:46. Raw бил unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0045:b002:l032: Кынжы rendered collar, in agreement with the on-the-neck location and Yudakhin кынжыла- at https://el-sozduk.kg/кын/ .
notes.manas-2010:p0046:b002:l001: Ылама retained as Ylama, apparently a named Kalmyk figure in this list; title lama remains possible, not resolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0046:b002:l011: Source has ninety here, against ninety-five camels elsewhere; numeral retained without harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0046:b002:l019: Жорго (ambling horse) retained as amblers with obedient added to express the metaphor of subjection; precise figurative force remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0046:b002:l029: Белгилүү жок, бел да жок is elliptical; champion and support are contextual interpretations of a known figure and a supporting back/ridge.
notes.manas-2010:p0046:b002:l033: Атаңдын көрү rendered with its literal father/grave curse; world is supplied from the nearby recurring алакчы дүйнө formula at 47:7.
notes.manas-2010:p0046:b002:l037: First-person lament begins contextually at 37 and closes at 44; these English quotation marks are interpretive, as source punctuation does not mark every speech transition.
notes.manas-2010:p0047:b002:l015: Кырмышанын Мурадыл preserved as Muradyl of Kyrmysha; exact referent and name morphology unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0047:b002:l035: Очогор treated as a gun listed alongside the battle-axe, not a type of axe. Yudakhin’s firearm example at https://el-sozduk.kg/баргек/ and Manas encyclopedia weapon entry https://el-sozduk.kg/ЖӨКӨР/ support that reading.
notes.manas-2010:p0047:b002:l040: Жаң-жусу rendered commander as in prior batches; historical Chinese rank equivalence not certified.
notes.manas-2010:p0041:b002:l005: Lexical correction: таш сайынган means a Chinese/Kalmyk official wearing a distinguishing ball/button on the cap, Yudakhin таш I.5 https://el-sozduk.kg/таш/. In this formula таза means finest, not bald/shaven: Yudakhin таза3 https://el-sozduk.kg/ТАЗ/. Raw source unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0047:b002:l017: Lexical correction: таш сайынган means a Chinese/Kalmyk official wearing a distinguishing ball/button on the cap, Yudakhin таш I.5 https://el-sozduk.kg/таш/. In this formula таза means finest, not bald/shaven: Yudakhin таза3 https://el-sozduk.kg/ТАЗ/. Raw source unchanged.
